config.emi.tooltip.distraction_free.show: Shows a hint that you can search to see recipes.
Shows a "Show Recipes" button where the hidden sidebar is. Clicking it pins the sidebar open, and a "Hide Recipes" button hides it again.
config.emi.tooltip.distraction_free.lowe: Makes the background of EMI's search bar translucent so that it blends in more.
config.emi.tooltip.distraction_free.pin_:
Pins the sidebar open so that it stays visible without searching, or closes it again.
Unbound by default.
config.emi.tooltip.distraction_free.pinn:
Whether the sidebar is pinned open right now. The pin bind and the buttons change this.
The state is saved.
config.emi.tooltip.distraction_free.fade:
How long the sidebar takes to fade and slide in and out, in milliseconds.
0 shows and hides it instantly. Maximum 2000.
config.emi.tooltip.distraction_free.appl: Hide the sidebar until you search in the player inventory (survival and creative).
Hide the sidebar until you search in the crafting table.
Hide the sidebar until you search in all other screens that show it: chests, furnaces, villagers and so on.
config.emi.tooltip.distraction_free.keep: EMI's recipe screen and recipe tree screen always show their sidebars. When off, they hide the sidebar until you search, too.
config.emi.tooltip.distraction_free.excl:
Screens that always keep the sidebar visible, whatever the switches above say.
Comma separated class names: a simple name (GenericContainerScreen) or a full name (net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.ingame.GenericContainerScreen).
Super classes count too.
